fuente.titulo: Pope Leo: the Church needs artists

titular: Pope Leo: Church needs artists in digital age
bajada: He said artists help make the Gospel understandable amid search-engine culture
caption: Pope Leo XIV told artists gathered for a Vatican meeting on culture that the Church needs their creativity, especially “in the age of search engines,” to help make the Gospel “accessible and understandable.” The address came during a gathering titled “The Art of Possibility: Weaving Together,” promoted by the Dicastery for Culture and Education. Source: Vatican News, Oct 2, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: A quiet Vatican hall with easels and sculptures displayed, soft natural light, the pope figure greeting artists in the upper right third, left and center space open and calm.
